title: Best Buy and Amazon Expand Fire TV Partnership Into Connected TV Advertising
summary: Best Buy (NYSE:BBY) and Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN) have expanded their multiyear Fire TV partnership to include connected television advertising, extending an existing agreement covering Best Buy’s Insignia TVs. Under the agreement, Fire TV will remain the exclusive software experience across all Insignia televisions produced by Best Buy, with models ranging from 24 to 85 inches.
